_comment: Plain-spoken narration. The screen carries the technical detail — the revert string, the contract address, the rail — so the voice does not have to. `lines` are the on-screen captions, shown in order across the beat, split proportionally by length.

beats.text: Your AI assistant just bought something for you. Did you actually want it? The shop can't tell either. And there is no rule anywhere for "my assistant did it" — so most shops would rather not take that order at all.
lines: Your AI assistant just bought something for you.
Did you actually want it? The shop can't tell either.
There's no rule anywhere for "my assistant did it" —
so most shops would rather not take the order at all.

beats.cue: agent buys; order appears; countdown starts
beats.text: GRACE gives every one of those payments a ninety second pause. The shop gets a signed promise right away. It just can't collect on it yet.
lines: GRACE gives every one of those payments a ninety second pause.
The shop gets a signed promise right away.
It just can't collect on it yet.

beats.text: Here is the shop trying to collect early.
lines: Here's the shop trying to collect early.

beats.text: Not yet valid. That is not our server saying no. That is the money itself refusing.
lines: "Not yet valid."
That's not our server saying no.
That's the money itself refusing.

beats.text: And during that pause, you can kill it. One tap. That just happened for real, on a live blockchain, with real Singapore dollars.
lines: And during that pause, you can kill it. One tap.
That just happened for real, on a live blockchain,
with real Singapore dollars.

beats.text: Now look at the balance. It never moved. There is nothing to refund, because the money never left your wallet.
lines: Now look at the balance. It never moved.
There's nothing to refund —
the money never left your wallet.

beats.cue: footer strip, then back to top
beats.text: Say nothing, and it goes through on its own, and it is final. Nobody ever held your money. Nobody had to.
lines: Say nothing, and it goes through on its own. And it's final.
Nobody ever held your money.
Nobody had to.
